text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence, such as learning, problem-solving, and understanding language. Machine learning is a key part of AI: instead of following fixed rules, computers learn from data and improve with experience. Deep learning, a more advanced form, uses artificial neural networks inspired by the human brain to recognise patterns in large amounts of information. AI is already part of our daily lives. It helps us find information online, suggests films we might enjoy, powers voice assistants on our phones, and even supports doctors in making better decisions.
